title: Four updates, one pass
notes: Eight zeros and four updates: A[1..6] += 2, A[0..4] += 3, A[3..7] −= 1, A[5..7] += 4. Each writes two cells of D, so D = 3 2 0 −1 0 1 0 −2 −3, and one pass of running sums gives A = 3 5 5 4 4 5 5 3. 8 writes and 8 sums, against 19 writes for adding to every cell.
